title: Migrate coap_waypoints.c + coap_location.c + checkin_resource.c mutating handlers to shared authorize helper
description: Child of worker6-l9hb decomposition. close_reason: Migrated the audited mutating sites to the shared helpers (cherry-picked helper ae3b6ae58a available on beads-worker-2): coap_waypoints.c lichen_waypoints_post_handler + lichen_waypoint_detail_delete_handler, coap_location.c sensors_location_post, checkin_resource.c checkin/rollcall/config handlers (3).
